findings.summary: A failed post-freeze native UI gate does not mandate focused repair, affected-check rerun, new freeze/SHA/evidence, and native UI re-review before final review.
Checkpoint B changes the required Context/server boundary but lacks an executable API plus server TypeScript gate at that reversible checkpoint.
The durable plan header identifies candidate repair 1 although the reviewed candidate is repair 2.

nextAuthority: A fresh Settings GLM plan successor requires explicit human authorization; no repair 3 or implementation activation is permitted.
